name: Legends Arena
desc:
Welcome to Legends Arena!

Chaos meets comedy in an epic showdown of characters from across the multiverse! Fight in this action-packed battlegrounds game as any character, hero, or villain to prove you are the strongest. Join the battleground today!

This experience blends inspiration from popular anime, comics, shows, and cartoons.

FAQ:
- Double jump to activate your character's passive.
- 👍💎 New rewards daily and every 1000 likes. 
- 💵 Gain cash from quests, chests, and fighting. 
- 👤 Try out new characters for free weekly! The free character rotation refreshes every Monday or when a new character is added.
- 🗝 Chests spawn every 5 minutes and can contain 50 to 200 cash.

Roblox Premium members receive x2 daily rewards.
